prompt:
Render a clean, straight-on image of a single WMO SURFACE STATION MODEL glyph that combines TWO standard elements, both of which you must draw correctly:

1. SKY COVER: the station CIRCLE is shaded to show total cloud cover in OKTAS (eighths). Shade exactly 6 of the 8 eighths of the circle black (and leave the other 2 eighths white) to show 6 oktas of cover.

2. WIND BARB: a straight shaft points out from the circle (up and to the right). On the shaft draw the wind speed using FULL feathers, where each full feather (a full-length barb) means 10 knots. For a 30-knot wind, draw exactly 3 full feathers hanging off the far end of the shaft.

So draw one circle shaded to 6/8 with a shaft carrying exactly 3 full feathers. Draw only this one station glyph; print no numbers or text inside or beside it. Make the shading fraction and the feathers clear.
easy_question: Never mind how well it is drawn. Does this picture show a WMO station model glyph with a shaded sky-cover circle and a wind barb with feathers? A realistic photo, an illustration, a schematic or a clean diagram ALL count as yes. Answer NO only if the image instead shows just a blank card or plain panel that prints an answer with none of that shown, or shows something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

reference.q_fill: This is a close-up of a circle that is partly filled in solid black. How much of the circle's area is filled solid black? Answer as a number of EIGHTHS from 0 to 8 (0 = none black, 4 = half black, 8 = all black). Answer with the single integer number of eighths (0 to 8) only.
reference.q_feathers: This is a close-up of a straight line (a shaft) with short strokes attached near one end. How many FULL-LENGTH strokes are drawn on it? Count only the long ones that run the full stroke length; do not count any half-length stubs. Answer with a single whole number only.

steps.target: the wind barb shaft with its feathers -- draw ONE box holding the straight shaft together with the short strokes on its far end, running from where the shaft leaves the circle out to the shaft's far tip; the shaded station circle must stay OUTSIDE the rectangle, and do not box the circle on its own, a single feather on its own, or the blank paper.
